question: Which of the following is NOT a private sector industry in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL)** is a **public sector undertaking (PSU)** in India and not a private sector industry.
 
• It is owned by the **Government of India** and operates under the Ministry of Heavy Industries.
